The first entry in a workbook that has been open on the bench for years without anyone writing in it.

What this is for

Short pieces about the work: how a garment gets chosen, what a fabric does after fifty washes, why a seam sits where it does. Written when there is something worth saying, not on a schedule.

A note on the order of things

Posts here are drafted in the repository, reviewed like any other change, and only then published by hand. Nothing reaches the storefront because a script decided it was ready.

Where to start

If you are looking for sizing rather than reading, the refund policy covers what happens when a guess turns out wrong, and the size chart on each product page is measured from the actual blank rather than copied from a supplier sheet.

Further reading on fabric weight, from a source that has no stake in what we sell: ASTM International.
